page: Hetzner Cloud cx53 is an x86_64 virtual machine running on the QEMU hypervisor. It is equipped with 16 vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC processor running at 2.0 GHz, featuring 16 physical cores with 1 thread per core under a shared CPU allocation model. The system includes 31.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 1.95 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is provided via a bundled 320 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or dedicated GPU hardware.

Performance benchmarks indicate a mixed profile. The single-core CPU performance measured via stress-ng is strong, placing in the top 25%, and text generation for small LLM models also demonstrates strong performance. However, Geekbench single-core and text processing scores are poor, falling into the bottom 10%. Most other metrics, including multi-core CPU performance, memory bandwidth, software compilation, ray tracing, and database operations, consistently rank in the average tier.

Given its shared CPU allocation and 1:2 RAM-to-vCPU ratio, the cx53 offers a resource-dense configuration suitable for workloads that require multi-threaded processing but do not demand sustained, dedicated CPU cores. The bundled 320 GB NVMe SSD provides fast local storage, making it a viable option for web serving, multi-threaded decompression tasks, and moderate database operations. However, the shared CPU model and lower per-core memory allocation represent a tradeoff for memory-intensive or sustained high-performance computing tasks.
